title: MacSteam Artifact Source Identity
description: Schema for source identity JSON files tracking provenance of downloaded artifacts

schemaVersion.description: Schema version identifier; must be 1 for this schema revision

provider.description: Provider or mechanism used to acquire the artifact

repositoryProbeStatus.description: HTTP status code or status indicator from repository probe

requestedHead.description: The requested git commit reference (40-character hex SHA)

observedHead.description: The observed git commit that was actually resolved (40-character hex SHA)

bundleSha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the downloaded bundle (optional)
